_note: Candidate registry for South Carolina 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (South Carolina State Election Commission, Candidate Tracking (Candidate Listing), 11/3/2026 Statewide General Election, searched by office (Governor and Lieutenant Governor, U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives), with Candidate Status column, as of 2026-10-16, linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: South Carolina State Election Commission, Candidate Tracking (Candidate Listing), 11/3/2026 Statewide General Election, searched by office (Governor and Lieutenant Governor, U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives), with Candidate Status column, as of 2026-10-16 (https://vrems.scvotes.sc.gov/Candidate/CandidateSearch?electionId=22596); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
